title: Start portable work in a customer project

sources.basis: Draft black-box stakeholder situation for IR-009 common Skills-product behavior. The Scenario awaits independent semantic review and does not claim detailed specialist clause migration or runtime evidence.

Draft black-box stakeholder situation for IR-009 common Skills-product behavior. The Scenario awaits independent semantic review and does not claim detailed specialist clause migration or runtime evidence.

Independent review and author reconciliation confirmed this stakeholder situation, primary Feature, and SR coverage as current analysis knowledge. This does not approve requirements or establish implemented behavior or satisfaction.

actor: A contributor using an engineering agent in a customer project
goal: Start an authorized specialist task with the project's own context and a safe output target.
context: The project does not contain RigorLoop repository-internal designs or governed change records.
trigger: The contributor invokes a supported portable engineering capability.

interaction.action: Supplies the requested outcome, relevant project instructions, and an authorized output target.
Identifies the capability scope, project-local inputs, applicable authority, and triggered resources.
Explains the portable procedure and any actual unmet prerequisite.

expected_outcome: The contributor can begin the supported portable task without manufacturing RigorLoop internals or requiring CLI recording.

alternatives.condition: The project already supplies an unambiguous authorized default target.
alternatives.outcome: The system uses that target within its existing authority.

failures.condition: The target or project authority is ambiguous.
failures.outcome: The system identifies the unresolved boundary and stops dependent action.

failures.condition: A governed signal is malformed or conflicting.
failures.outcome: The system reports the conflict without silently falling back to ungoverned writes.
